dataset.name: Frozen public blog section-evidence regression
dataset.license: Public blog content retains its source rights; evaluation snapshot included for this repository owner, not relicensed as MIT
dataset.scope: Project/agent-authored source-bound retrieval regression; not independent human-validated ground truth, blind holdout, current implementation facts, or generation-quality evidence.
dataset.annotation_status: Authored before retrieval runs; exact quotes, revisions and ranges checked by loader. Independent human semantic annotation review pending. No LLM Judge used.
dataset.snapshot_note: All10 publicly visible articles retained, including an empty title and a short unrelated post. Historic architecture claims are evaluated as article content, not current production facts.

splits.method: SHA256 family modulo4; 0=dev, others=test; all is diagnostic union
splits.dev: Development labels; no parameter tuning in this run
splits.test: Public visible held-out query families for this run, not independent authorship or secret holdout
splits.all: Diagnostic union; never an independent test score

annotations.passage_requirement: Each flat span is required; equal optional group labels represent alternatives. Every selected range requires complete source-character coverage.
annotations.no_answer: Five authored nonexistent identifiers; returned candidates do not establish generation hallucination.
